mapper.select: SELECT BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bankAccountId, ID AS id, BANK_NAME AS bankName, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType FROM BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE ID = #{ownerId} ORDER BY BANK_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT_ID

SELECT BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bankAccountId, ID AS id, BANK_NAME AS bankName, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType FROM BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId} AND ID = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BANK_ACCOUNT (BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, ID, BANK_NAME, BALANCE, ACCOUNT_TYPE) VALUES (#{bankAccountId}, #{id}, #{bankName}, #{balance}, #{accountType})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId} AND ID = #{ownerId}
